title.zh: 美国10月通胀高于预期,12月加息几成定局,美股三大指数回落,黄金重挫、油价续跌
title.en: Hotter US inflation makes a December Fed hike fully priced in: Wall Street slips, gold tumbles and oil keeps sliding

points.zh: 美国10月CPI月增0.4%,高于预期的0.3%;据CME FedWatch,12月加息25个基点已被市场完全定价。
points.en: US October CPI rose 0.4% versus the 0.3% forecast; CME FedWatch shows a 25-basis-point December hike fully priced in.

points.zh: 英伟达因董事会调查CEO黄仁勋而连续两天下跌,拖累科技板块;台积电10月营收创纪录。
points.en: Nvidia fell for a second day on the board probe into CEO Jensen Huang, dragging tech; TSMC posted record October sales.

points.zh: 富时隆综指周二收1,604.07点,跌0.77%,银行与数据中心权重股承压。
points.en: The FBM KLCI closed Tuesday at 1,604.07, down 0.77%, with banking and data-centre heavyweights weighing.

takeaway.zh: 通胀数据好比一张天气预报,告诉我们利率这把伞可能要撑得更久。信托基金顾问通常提醒:短期波动不必惊慌,回到自己的目标与风险承受度,定期定额的节奏比猜测每一个数据更重要。
takeaway.en: Inflation data is like a weather forecast telling us the interest-rate umbrella may stay up longer. A unit trust consultant would generally remind you that short-term swings need not cause panic: return to your goals and risk tolerance, because a steady regular-investing rhythm matters more than guessing every data point.

title.zh: 美国10月CPI月增0.4%高于预期,Waller称12月应加息,标普500跌0.38%
title.en: Hot US CPI of 0.4% and Waller's call for a December hike send the S&P 500 down 0.38%

analysis.zh: 据路透社(经Yahoo Finance转载)报道,美国10月消费者物价月增0.4%,高于经济学家预期的0.3%,9月为0.6%。联储局理事Waller表示12月应加息,若通胀恶化可考虑加息半个百分点;CME FedWatch显示12月至少加息25个基点已被完全定价,加息50个基点的概率升至11.8%。标普500收7,520.93点(-0.38%),道指52,231.89点(-0.30%),纳指25,065.87点(-0.74%);2年期美债收益率上升约18.9个基点至4.736%。就像家里的冷气费一路上涨,大家开始担心预算要重新调整。
analysis.en: Reuters, via Yahoo Finance, reported that US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October versus the 0.3% economists expected, after 0.6% in September. Fed Governor Waller said the Fed should raise rates in December and consider a half-point move if inflation worsens; CME FedWatch showed at least a 25-basis-point December hike fully priced in, with the odds of 50 basis points rising to 11.8%. The S&P 500 closed at 7,520.93 (-0.38%), the Dow at 52,231.89 (-0.30%) and the Nasdaq at 25,065.87 (-0.74%); the 2-year Treasury yield jumped about 18.9 basis points to 4.736%. It is like a household's air-conditioning bill creeping up: everyone starts wondering whether the budget needs adjusting.

dda.zh: 利率预期上升时市场常会震荡,但定期定额(DDA)让你按固定预算持续投入,在高低起伏中摊平成本。长期投资者通常更看重多年的目标,而不是单日的数据。
dda.en: Markets often wobble when rate expectations rise, but regular (DDA) investing lets you keep contributing a fixed budget, which may smooth your average cost through the ups and downs. Long-term investors generally focus on multi-year goals rather than one day's data.

prs.zh: 退休规划以数十年计,一份通胀数据不必改变整体计划。可以借此检查退休基金的风险水平是否仍合适;PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑因素之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning runs over decades, so one inflation print need not change the whole plan. It may be a good moment to check whether your retirement fund's risk level still suits you; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one factor in keeping contributions steady.

lump.zh: 面对利率与通胀的不确定性,单笔投资的一般原则是:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查是否过度集中于某类资产,并确认金额与目标和风险承受度相符。
lump.en: With rate and inflation uncertainty, the general principles for a lump sum are: phasing in may spread timing risk, check you are not over-concentrated in one asset type, and make sure the amount matches your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 美国加息预期上升、美债收益率走高,可能影响全球债券价格,也可能牵动令吉与外资流向,进而间接影响马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)。国家银行的OPR立场与本地通胀仍是更直接的因素;债券基金在组合中一般扮演平衡角色。
bond.en: Rising US hike expectations and Treasury yields may affect global bond prices and could influence the ringgit and foreign flows, indirectly touching Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). Bank Negara's OPR stance and local inflation remain more direct drivers; bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 英伟达因黄仁勋调查案连跌两天,周二再跌约5.4%,科技板块领跌
title.en: Nvidia falls for a second day on the Jensen Huang probe, down about 5.4% Tuesday and leading tech lower

analysis.zh: CNBC报道,英伟达在董事会就CEO黄仁勋与一名被指为中国间谍的女子的关系展开调查后连续第二天下跌,董事会已聘请Wachtell Lipton主持调查。据路透社报道,英伟达周二跌5.4%,两个交易日累计下跌9.6%,标普500科技板块下跌1.4%,费城半导体指数跌0.4%。公司表示没有理由相信国家安全或商业机密受到损害。领导层的不确定性,就像一艘大船的船长被质疑,乘客自然会紧张。
analysis.en: CNBC reported that Nvidia fell for a second straight day after its board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, and has hired Wachtell Lipton to lead it. Reuters reported Nvidia fell 5.4% on Tuesday and 9.6% over two sessions, the S&P 500 tech sector dropped 1.4% and the Philadelphia semiconductor index lost 0.4%. The company has said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Leadership uncertainty is like questions about a big ship's captain: passengers naturally feel uneasy.

dda.zh: 许多信托基金都持有大型科技股,单一公司的消息可能带来短期波动。定期定额通常能让你不必猜测个别公司的消息,并通过分散投资降低单一股票的影响。
dda.en: Many unit trusts hold large technology shares, so news on a single company may bring short-term swings. Regular investing generally means you need not second-guess individual-company news, and diversified funds may reduce the impact of any one stock.

prs.zh: 退休基金通常持有广泛分散的组合,单一公司事件对数十年的退休目标影响有限。可留意基金的科技股占比,并确认风险水平与退休年期相符。
prs.en: Retirement funds are usually broadly diversified, so one company's event generally has limited bearing on a decades-long goal. It may help to look at a fund's technology weighting and confirm the risk level suits your retirement timeline.

lump.zh: 热门股突然下跌提醒我们集中风险的重要。单笔投资的一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查组合是否过度集中于少数科技公司,并确认金额符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: A sudden drop in a popular stock is a reminder of concentration risk. General lump-sum principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check the portfolio is not over-concentrated in a few tech names, and match the amount to your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这则消息对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响通常有限;若科技股抛售引发避险情绪,资金可能流向较稳健的资产。债券基金在股市波动时一般起到平衡组合的作用,但仍需留意利率与信用风险。
bond.en: The direct effect on Malaysian bond funds is generally limited; if a tech sell-off prompts risk aversion, money may move toward steadier assets. Bond funds generally help balance a portfolio when equities swing, though interest-rate and credit risks still matter.

title.zh: 美国CPI高于预期,现货黄金一度跌约2.8%至US$4,021,仍守住US$4,000关口
title.en: Gold drops as much as 2.8% to about US$4,021 on hot CPI but holds above US$4,000

analysis.zh: 据CNBC引述路透社报道,美国10月CPI月增0.4%,高于预期的0.3%,美元与美债收益率上升,现货黄金下跌2.8%至每盎司US$4,021.36,12月期货跌1.9%至US$4,036.00,白银跌3.9%至US$51.32。CME FedWatch显示12月加息25个基点已完全定价,加息50个基点的概率升至10.5%。Marex的Edward Meir称这对黄金是「短期的小幅利空」,渣打银行则指黄金仍在关键的US$4,000上方交易。黄金不生息,利率走高时持有成本就像放着不生利息的存款,显得更高。
analysis.en: CNBC, citing Reuters, reported that after US October CPI rose 0.4% versus the 0.3% forecast, the dollar and Treasury yields rose and spot gold fell 2.8% to US$4,021.36 an ounce, with December futures down 1.9% at US$4,036.00 and silver down 3.9% at US$51.32. CME FedWatch shows a 25-basis-point December hike fully priced in, with the odds of 50 basis points rising to 10.5%. Marex's Edward Meir called it "a bit of a short-term negative for gold", while Standard Chartered said gold continues to trade above the critical US$4,000 mark. Gold pays no interest, so when rates rise the cost of holding it looks higher.

dda.zh: 黄金价格短期波动较大,单日的跌幅不代表长期方向。长期投资者通常以分散配置的角度看待黄金,并通过定期定额(DDA)的节奏降低对单一价位的依赖。
dda.en: Gold can be volatile in the short run, and one day's fall does not set the long-term direction. Long-term investors generally view gold as part of diversification, and a regular (DDA) rhythm can reduce reliance on any single price level.

prs.zh: 退休规划可参考不同资产在不同环境下的表现,黄金价格的波动提醒我们分散的价值。PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免,仍是持续供款的参考因素之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning can draw on how different assets behave in different environments, and gold's swings remind us of diversification's value. The PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year remains one consideration for steady contributions.

lump.zh: 价格大幅波动时更不宜凭情绪行动。单笔投资的一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查是否过度集中于单一资产,并确认金额与目标和风险承受度相符。
lump.en: Sharp price swings are when acting on emotion is least helpful. General lump-sum principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check for over-concentration in one asset, and match the amount to your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 美元走强与美债收益率上升可能牵动令吉与外资流向,对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)产生间接影响。国家银行的OPR与本地通胀仍是主要因素;债券基金一般在组合中扮演平衡角色。
bond.en: A stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields may influence the ringgit and foreign flows, with indirect effects on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). Bank Negara's OPR and local inflation remain the main factors; bond funds generally play a balancing role.

title.zh: 特朗普称伊朗战争或将很快结束,布伦特原油一度跌破US$90,收报US$91.49
title.en: Brent briefly dips below US$90 on Iran peace hopes and settles at US$91.49

analysis.zh: CNBC报道,布伦特原油周二收跌1.17%至每桶US$91.49,盘中低见US$89.16,为8月以来首次跌破US$90;WTI跌0.93%至US$86.04。特朗普称伊朗战争「很快会结束」,经霍尔木兹海峡的石油流量已大致恢复。ING分析师认为市场正在消化地缘政治风险溢价,但FGE的Fereidun Fesharaki认为双方分歧「大到无法弥合」。今年布伦特年初约US$60,3至4月曾升至约US$130,波动之大像坐过山车。
analysis.en: CNBC reported Brent settled down 1.17% at US$91.49 a barrel on Tuesday, touching a session low of US$89.16, its first dip below US$90 since August; WTI fell 0.93% to US$86.04. Trump said the Iran war "is going to be ending fairly soon" and oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have largely recovered. ING analysts said the market is removing geopolitical risk premium, while FGE's Fereidun Fesharaki said the gap between the sides is "so wide, it cannot be bridged". Brent started the year near US$60 and rose to about US$130 in March-April, a roller-coaster ride.

dda.zh: 油价是影响通胀的重要变量,波动时更需要纪律。定期定额(DDA)让你不必猜测油价走向,按预算持续投入,长期可能摊平成本。
dda.en: Oil is an important driver of inflation, and discipline matters more when it swings. Regular (DDA) investing means you do not have to guess oil's direction; steady contributions may smooth your cost over time.

prs.zh: 能源价格影响物价,也影响退休后的生活成本。规划退休目标时可适度考虑通胀因素;PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Energy prices affect everyday costs, including living costs in retirement, so it can help to factor inflation into retirement goals. The PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one consideration for steady contributions.

lump.zh: 地缘新闻带来的价格波动难以预测。单笔投资的一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查是否过度集中于能源等单一板块,并确认金额符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Geopolitical headlines make prices hard to predict. General lump-sum principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check for over-concentration in a sector such as energy, and match the amount to your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 油价下跌可能缓和通胀压力,对债券市场通常偏正面,但马来西亚债券基金仍主要受国家银行OPR、令吉与外资流向影响。若油价回升,可能再度推高通胀预期;债券基金在组合中一般起平衡作用。
bond.en: Lower oil may ease inflation pressure, which is generally supportive for bonds, but Malaysian bond funds still respond mainly to Bank Negara's OPR, the ringgit and foreign flows. If oil rebounds it could lift inflation expectations again; bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: Bursa Malaysia周二收低,富时隆综指跌12.51点至1,604.07,银行与数据中心权重股承压
title.en: Bursa Malaysia ends lower Tuesday as the FBM KLCI falls 12.51 points to 1,604.07 on banking and data-centre drag

analysis.zh: The Star报道,富时隆综指周二收报1,604.07点,下跌12.51点或0.77%,上周五收市为1,616.58点;早盘高开至1,626.55点,盘中低见1,595.26点。下跌股746只,上涨股395只,成交27.9亿股、价值RM27.7亿。分析师指YTL Power的疲弱与对云端巨头融资及AI基建投资可能延后的担忧有关,并预期本周指数在1,590至1,620点之间,守住1,600点被视为短期稳定的关键。高开后一路走低,像一场冲高回落的拉锯战。
analysis.en: The Star reported the FBM KLCI closed Tuesday at 1,604.07, down 12.51 points or 0.77%, against Friday's close of 1,616.58; it opened at 1,626.55 and touched an intraday low of 1,595.26. Decliners beat gainers 746 to 395, on turnover of 2.79 billion units worth RM2.77 billion. An analyst linked YTL Power's weakness to concerns over hyperscaler financing and possible delays in AI infrastructure investment, and expects the index to trade between 1,590 and 1,620 this week, with holding above 1,600 seen as key to near-term stability. A strong open fading all day is like a tug-of-war that ends with a small step back.

dda.zh: 本地股市的单日起落只是长期旅程中的一小段。定期定额(DDA)让你不必每天判断行情,按预算持续投入,成本可能在起伏中被摊平。
dda.en: One day's move in the local market is a small stretch of a long journey. Regular (DDA) investing means you do not need to judge each day; steady contributions within your budget may smooth your average cost.

prs.zh: 退休规划通常以数十年计,指数一天的变化不必改变计划。PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑,但应先确认基金的风险水平与退休年期相符。
prs.en: Retirement plans generally run for decades, so one day's index move need not change the plan. The PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can support steady contributions, once the fund's risk level suits your retirement timeline.

lump.zh: 银行股与数据中心相关股同时承压,提醒我们留意单一板块的集中度。一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,并确认金额符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Banks and data-centre-linked stocks falling together is a reminder to watch sector concentration. General principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should match your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 股市日内波动对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响通常有限,债券基金更受国家银行OPR立场、通胀、令吉与外资流向影响。股市起伏时,债券基金一般扮演平衡组合的角色。
bond.en: Daily equity swings generally have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, which respond more to Bank Negara's OPR stance, inflation, the ringgit and foreign flows. When equities swing, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 台积电10月营收达NT$5,869亿创纪录,年增59.7%,全年增长预期上调至约44%
title.en: TSMC's October sales hit a record NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7%, and its 2026 growth outlook is lifted to about 44%

analysis.zh: Focus Taiwan报道,台积电10月营收NT$5,869亿(约US$178.1亿),较去年同期增长59.7%、较9月增长14.7%,超越8月NT$5,148亿的纪录;分析师将增长归功于AI需求,尤其是2纳米制程芯片出货。1至10月累计营收增长43.3%至NT$4.49万亿,公司将2026年美元营收增长预期上调至约44%,第四季指引为US$523亿至543亿。AI需求像一场长跑,台积电这一棒跑得特别快。
analysis.en: Focus Taiwan reported TSMC's October sales reached NT$586.89 billion (about US$17.81 billion), up 59.7% year-on-year and 14.7% from September, topping August's NT$514.81 billion record; analysts credited AI demand, especially shipments of chips on the 2nm process. January-October sales rose 43.3% to NT$4.49 trillion, and the company raised its 2026 US-dollar growth forecast to about 44%, with fourth-quarter guidance of US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion. AI demand is like a long relay, and TSMC is running a very fast leg.

dda.zh: AI与半导体是许多全球信托基金的重要主题,但板块波动也较大。定期定额(DDA)有助于在长期内分散进场时点,而不是押注单一时机。
dda.en: AI and semiconductors are a major theme in many global unit trusts, but the sector can also be volatile. Regular (DDA) investing may help spread entry points over the long run rather than relying on a single moment.

prs.zh: 退休基金若含科技或亚洲股票,可留意其对半导体板块的敞口。退休规划着眼数十年,宜检查风险水平是否适合;PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑。
prs.en: If a retirement fund holds technology or Asian equities, it may help to look at its semiconductor exposure. Retirement planning spans decades, so check the risk level suits you; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one factor in steady contributions.

lump.zh: 强劲数据也可能带来过高的期待。单笔投资的一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查是否过度集中于芯片或科技板块,并确认金额符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Strong data can also create lofty expectations. General lump-sum principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check for over-concentration in chips or tech, and match the amount to your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台积电的业绩对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限。不过亚洲半导体需求也牵动马来西亚的电子业出口与外资流向,间接影响令吉;债券基金一般在组合中扮演平衡角色。
bond.en: TSMC's results have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds. Asian chip demand can, however, touch Malaysia's electronics exports and foreign flows, indirectly affecting the ringgit; bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 台股加权指数周二收涨2.52%至42,711.92点,成交NT$1万亿
title.en: Taiwan shares close up 2.52% at 42,711.92 on NT$1 trillion turnover

analysis.zh: Focus Taiwan报道,台股加权指数周二收报42,711.92点,上涨1,050.22点或2.52%,成交额NT$1万亿(约US$306.1亿)。这是继周一在政府干预承诺下创下第二大单日点数涨幅之后的又一次大涨;另一篇报道称台湾11月已出现约US$100亿的资金外流。指数大起大落,像坐电梯,上下都很快。
analysis.en: Focus Taiwan reported the Taiwan stock index closed Tuesday at 42,711.92, up 1,050.22 points or 2.52%, on turnover of NT$1 trillion (about US$30.61 billion). It follows Monday's second-largest daily point gain on an intervention pledge; a separate Focus Taiwan report noted about US$10 billion of capital outflows from Taiwan in November. A market that swings this hard is like an elevator: fast in both directions.

dda.zh: 亚洲市场的急涨急跌提醒我们短期难以预测。定期定额(DDA)让你按预算持续投入,不必在高低点之间做判断。
dda.en: Sharp rises and falls in Asian markets remind us that the short term is hard to predict. Regular (DDA) investing lets you contribute steadily within your budget without calling highs and lows.

prs.zh: 若退休基金包含亚洲或新兴市场股票,波动可能较大。可检查基金的风险水平与退休年期是否相符;PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑。
prs.en: If a retirement fund holds Asian or emerging-market equities, volatility may be larger. Check that the fund's risk level matches your retirement timeline; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one consideration for steady contributions.

lump.zh: 大涨之后更要避免追高的情绪。单笔投资的一般原则:分批进场可分散时间风险,检查是否过度集中于单一市场,并确认金额符合目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: After a big rally it is wise to avoid chasing. General lump-sum principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check for over-concentration in a single market, and match the amount to your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台股的涨跌对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响通常有限。亚洲资金流向的变化可能间接影响令吉与外资动向;债券基金在股市波动时一般扮演平衡组合的角色。
bond.en: Moves in Taiwan stocks generally have limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds. Shifts in Asian capital flows may indirectly affect the ringgit and foreign flows; when equities swing, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.
